review_candidate.reason: The exact 1.10 m x 1.50 m source surface maps to 352 x 480 integer texels at 320 px/m. A 16 px diagnostic cell is exactly 0.05 m in both source metric axes, yielding 22 x 30 physical cells while remaining inside one 512 x 512 review atlas. This is a bounded review density, not production adoption.

negative_control.description: Map the same unit-square structural chart across all 512 x 512 texels. This creates unequal physical texel density on the 1.10 m x 1.50 m source surface and is retained only as a visible fail-control.
